mechanism.claim: When the first eigenmode of six major altcoin minute returns newly enters its own upper-quartile dominance state, fragmented coin-specific trading has become a coherent crypto market impulse. During elevated BTC variation, the oriented common factor's final-hour direction should transmit into BTC for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the final-hour return vector projected onto the positively oriented current PC1 loading
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCMMI uses the eigenvalue share and oriented loading of an alt-return correlation matrix. HVCACFR used two BTC-versus-alt-median correlations; AFGI used price-free aggressive-flow geometry. No prior return-market-mode event set or control is reused.

literature_context.paper: Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu (2022), Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency
literature_context.supported_scope: a cryptocurrency market factor is a distinct common risk factor

mechanism.volatile_market_target: BTC completed eight-hour variation strict-prior rank >=0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse eight-hour alt-return eigenmode onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.aligned_window: 480 exact aligned bars_binance 1m OHLC rows [D-8h,D) for every alt
features.source_valid: each symbol has the exact common minute grid; finite positive OHLC with valid high/low; no duplicate, missing, nearest-time join or imputation
features.standardization: within-window population demean and population standard deviation per alt; every scale strictly positive
features.correlation: float64 six-by-six population correlation matrix of standardized minute returns
features.eigendecomposition: numpy.linalg.eigh; descending eigenvalues; clip only tiny negatives in [-1e-12,0] to zero; nonfinite or materially negative eigenvalue invalidates the state
features.pc1_variance_share: largest eigenvalue divided by the sum of six clipped eigenvalues
features.pc1_orientation: make loading sum positive; if abs(sum)<=1e-12, make the first frozen-universe maximum-absolute loading positive
features.mode_rank: strict-prior midrank of PC1 share over at most 270 earlier valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded
features.onset: current mode_dominant and immediately previous exact source-valid block mode_rank<0.75
features.direction_score: dot(oriented current PC1 loading, six final-60-minute cumulative log returns); finite and strict nonzero
features.btc_variation: sum of 480 squared BTC minute log(close/open) returns over [D-8h,D)
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact eight-hour boundary D after all source paths complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent six-alt return eigenmode ignition mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, window, eigenmode, rank, onset, side, variation, clock, hold, subset or control repair
